title: Gerudo Gear

{{Infobox Item |image= File:BotW Gerudo Scimitar Icon.png |caption= A [[Gerudo Scimitar]] from {{BotW|-}} |pronunciation= |plural= |type= |game= BotW, TotK |other= AoC |cost= |value= |location= |uses= {{List| * Attacking [[Enemy|Enemies]] * Defense }} |strength= |durability= |comp= {{List| * [[Desert Voe Set]] * [[Gerudo Outfit]] }} |sample= |theme= }} The {{Term/Store|Gerudo Gear|Gerudo Gear|Series, BotW}} is a recurring archetype of [[Weapon]] in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 172}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Gerudo Gear is weaponry crafted by the [[Gerudo]] and used by both travelers and soldiers.{{Cite|{{Big|Gerudo Shield}}
The design of this metal shield has changed over time to match the Gerudo's sword-and- shield fighting style. It's favored by soldiers and travelers alike.|Inventory|BotW}} It is characterized by its highly ornate designs.{{Cite|{{Big|Moonlight Scimitar}}
Delicate Gerudo carvings decorate this curved sword. The engraved blade is extremely sharp. Apparently it once served ceremonial purposes in festivals.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Golden Bow}}
This Gerudo-made bow is popular for the fine ornamentations along its limbs. Designed for hunting and warfare alike, this bow was engineered to strike distant targets.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Radiant Shield}}
This extravagant shield is presented to Gerudo warriors who rise to the rank of captain. Its apparent opulence is rivaled only by its combat capabilities.|Inventory|BotW}} Gerudo swords are distinguished by their distinctive curved blades.{{Cite|{{Big|Gerudo Scimitar}}
This common sword is often carried by Gerudo women for self-defense. Its short, curved blade is easily recognized.|Inventory|BotW}} All forms of Gerudo Gear are constructed with metal, meaning they will conduct [[Electricity]] and attract [[Lightning]] when they are equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]]. They sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but they can be picked up and manipulated with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. Finally, pieces of Gerudo Gear will not burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. ====List of Equipment==== {{Data Table |game= BotW |columns= Item [Image:Icon:144px][Term], Strength, Durability, Description [Transcript] |- | Gerudo Scimitar | 16 | 23 | This common sword is often carried by Gerudo women for self-defense. Its short, curved blade is easily recognized. |- | Moonlight Scimitar | 25 | 32 | Delicate Gerudo carvings decorate this curved sword. The engraved blade is extremely sharp. Apparently it once served ceremonial purposes in festivals. |- | Scimitar of the Seven | 32 | 60 | A famous sword once beloved by the Gerudo Champion Urbosa. It is said that when Urbosa swung this sword in battle, her movements resembled a beautiful dance. |- | Golden Claymore | 32 | 30 | Only the most talented Gerudo sword fighters carry this two-handed sword. It's actually much lighter than it appears and is surprisingly easy to wield. |- | Gerudo Spear | 16 | 35 | This spear's center of gravity is in its tip, making it a bit unwieldy for the average fighter. But in the hands of a skilled Gerudo warrior, it's a weapon of reliable strength. |- | Golden Bow | 14 | 60 | This Gerudo-made bow is popular for the fine ornamentations along its limbs. Designed for hunting and warfare alike, this bow was engineered to strike distant targets. |- | Gerudo Shield | 20 | 20 | The design of this metal shield has changed over time to match the Gerudo's sword-and- shield fighting style. It's favored by soldiers and travelers alike. |- | Radiant Shield | 35 | 26 | This extravagant shield is presented to Gerudo warriors who rise to the rank of captain. Its apparent opulence is rivaled only by its combat capabilities. |- | Daybreaker | 48 | 60 | This shield was cherished by the Gerudo Champion Urbosa. The gold used to make it was handpicked to ensure a design that is both lightweight and very durable. }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== [[Gloom]] has caused most Gerudo Gear [[Weapon]]s to have significantly reduced [[Durability]], but some uncorrupted Weapons can be found in the [[Depths]].
